package fixture

import (
	"context"

	"metaldocs/internal/platform/tenant"
)

// The incompatible nested closure is not the actorFromCtx resolver and must
// not be attributed to its compatible outer function.
func notAnActorFromCtxWithNestedCall(ctx context.Context) (string, string, error) {
	inner := func(context.Context) (int, int, error) {
		_, err := tenant.FromContext(ctx)
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	_ = inner
	return "", "", nil
}
